summary: Adds a `__str__` returning `str(self.value)` to the `Choices` base, correctly fixing the enum-value type mismatch so all subclasses (Text/IntegerChoices) print their value instead of `MyEnum.MEMBER`. This matches the actual upstream Django fix and is minimal and correct.

issues.description: Inserted blank line after the docstring contains trailing whitespace, which would trip flake8/isort-style checks; cosmetic only.
